title: Syntax and Running Code
learning_objectives: You can write valid Python statements without syntax errors
You can predict the output of basic print expressions

prerequisites_check.question: What happens when you run code with indentation errors in Python?
options: Python raises an IndentationError before execution
prerequisites_check.explanation: Python parses indentation during compilation, raising an IndentationError if blocks are malformed.

explanation_simple: Python reads instructions line by line, using indentation to know which lines belong together.
explanation_technical: CPython parses source code into an abstract syntax tree and compiles it to bytecode before execution in the virtual machine.

line_by_line.explanation: Calls the built-in print function with a string argument.

summary: Python executes statements in order and enforces structure using 4-space indentation.
